issue.description:
Parent: beadrs-9d740f26 (sub-split s3 of 5, claimant-owned credential fence). s1 fences the lifecycle mutations; s2 fences resource locks; s4 covers unclaimed passthrough and historical leases; s5 lands the whole fence. The override child (beadrs-dc8df464) and the concurrency regression child (beadrs-eec200d1) are later children of beadrs-8c343a7c and are OUT of scope here.

Scope:
- Require the exact current claim-epoch credential for atomic attempt resolve while the issue is claimed, leased or not.
- A missing or stale credential conflicts with exit code 4 and changes nothing: no attempt receipt written, no resolution recorded, no revision bump, no event.
- Credential validation and the resolve share one IMMEDIATE transaction, including attempt receipts and checkpoint-visible state.
- The current claimant with the exact current credential resolves as before.

Acceptance:
- Attempt resolve on a claimed issue without a credential exits 4 and the attempt state and revision are unchanged on re-read.
- A stale credential exits 4 and leaves the current claim and the attempt intact.
- The exact current credential succeeds.
- Regression coverage sits beside the existing attempt-resolution tests and runs in the default suite.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test pass.
issue.title: Gate atomic attempt resolve on the exact claim-epoch credential
